body.name: Four-channel phase diagram
body.construction: \(R_{\mathrm{or}}=\{\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s^2/n_s\}\vee[\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s(Tn_s)^{-\lambda/(2\lambda+d)}]^2\vee T^{-2\lambda/d}\) and \(R_{\star}=R_{\mathrm{or}}\vee N^{-\kappa}\), whose four entries are treated-mean noise, replicated-response smoothing, random-design spacing, and generated-path uncertainty.
